articles.title: The Founders of Hooters Are Making a Buddy-Comedy Movie About the Restaurant Chain's Origin Story
articles.summary: Yep, you read that right. Hooters: The Movie is in the early stages of pre-production, and some of the chain’s original founders are directly involved. As reported by Deadline, the film is inspired by the “real events” behind Hooters’ creation, following best buds Ted and Lenny as they create a…
body: Ted falls head over heels for a gal named Diane after seeing her on a TV commercial. Ted convinces Lenny to drive down with him to Clearwater Beach, Florida, where they recruit Diane to become the original Hooters Girl. The flick is described as part buddy comedy, part biopic that tells the “wild journey” of how the iconic American eatery got its start.

One of Hooters’ co-founders, Edward Droste, is both producing the film and co-authoring its screenplay. Jon Rosenbaum (Benchwarmers 2: Breaking Balls) is set to direct, and casting is already underway. Filming is scheduled to begin in November in Florida's Tampa and Clearwater areas, which is where the very first Hooters restaurant opened its doors all the way back in 1983.

“I think people are going to enjoy watching how we were really just some guys who didn’t know what we were doing, but had a great time doing it,” Droste said in a press release. “And of course, our world-famous Hooters Girls are the real stars. It’s time to deliver a taste of our big-hearted culture and famous humor to the world.”
points: Hooters: The Movie is in the early stages of pre-production, and some of the chain’s original founders are directly involved.

articles.title: Indie Dev Posts Video Reporting Stolen Laptops at gamescom as CD Projekt Red and More Step in to Help
articles.summary: Ryan Laley, the solo indie developer behind upcoming asymmetrical horror game Mimic, has shared a video confirming his gamescom was "cut short" after he and other developers had their laptops stolen.
body: A teary Laley took to X/Twitter to share a video explaining why his "gamescom is over early," saying that "all our laptops have been stolen" after he and others had their booths "raided" overnight. Bringing Mimic to the Cologne, Germany gaming event meant getting the opportunity to show it off to a new audience of potential partners and eager gamers alike, but stolen gear would bring that dream to an end.
"As an indie, solo dev, this s**t's expensive and hard to do all by yourself," he said. "And to have this happen is beyond frustrating – it's heartbreaking."

Laley went on, saying the gamescom theft was reported to the proper security teams and authorities. Despite the effort he and others were putting in, he noted, "I don't expect it, obviously, to be found or returned."
"I don't know what I'm going to do now," he added. "I can't do my job. We'll post updates if I get any updates, but effectively, gamescom is over for me."

articles.title: Tech Experts Call Grand Theft Auto 6 The Most Visually Advanced Game To Date, Which Explains Why It’s Stuck At 30FPS
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally had its first big gameplay reveal, giving us our first real look at Rockstar's massive open-world and the amount of detail it holds. It's one that might be the most visually-impressive game we've ever seen, according to the experts at Digital Foundry.
body: Digital Foundry's Oliver Mackenzie and Richard Leadbetter have praised GTA 6's visual presentation, with Mackenzie specifically going as far to call it the "most impressive example of real-time game rendering" he's ever seen. The pair praised a slew of details showcased in the gameplay, including standout character rendering, especially the hair physics and skin details across not just the game's protagonist, but many NPCs too.

Ray tracing use was also praised, with the pair pointing out how Rockstar has delicately implemented it in the right places for the biggest impact, and is leaning on older conventional methods in the pursuit for a better balance between fidelity and performance.

Performance was a big talking point too, especially so given how poorly GTA 5 performed on Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 when it initially launched. Rockstar has always seemingly favored the best looking image quality over the smoothest, but that seems to have changed with GTA 6. Digital Foundry noted that while the game was rendering at 30 frames per second, that target seems to be consistently hit, with the team rarely finding dips during its analysis of all 48,242 frames.
points: Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally had its first big gameplay reveal, giving us our first real look at Rockstar's massive open-world and the amount of detail it holds.

articles.title: The Apple AirPods Pro 3 Wireless Noise Canceling Earbuds Drops to Just $144
articles.summary: The AirPods Pro 3 is Apple's best earbuds and the perfect gift for any student heading back to school. While supplies last, Walmart is offering open box units for just $144 with free shipping. They are sold and shipped by Walmart direct and are in "excellent condition with no signs of usage".
body: The AirPods Pro 3 launched late last year and is currently still the newest generation AirPods Pro. Like its predecessor, this is easily the best earbuds for anyone who uses an iPhone. Although it looks pretty similar to the 2nd gen AirPods, there are some pretty significant improvements under the hood. The most notable new feature is the built-in heart rate sensing (which means you may not need an Apple Watch anymore), but the AirPods Pro 3 improves in other subtle ways as well, including better audio quality, better noise cancelation, long battery life, and a more weatherproof IP57 shell.

Released alongside the AirPods Pro 3 was Apple's "Live Translation", which is an Apple Intelligence feature that translates other languages on the fly. This isn't exclusive to the AirPods Pro since it can also be used with the 2nd gen AirPods Pro and the AirPods 4. body: Accidentally included in a build of NBA 2K27 (via VideoCardz ), an early version of DLSS 5 was accessed and made useable by the RenoDX modding community, who quickly developed a crude toolset allowing anyone to use the suite across a variety of games. These ranged from extensive tests on Control, Cyberpunk 2077, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, and even Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, each showcasing some of the benefits and the many, many drawbacks of the heavily AI-reliant post-processing that Nvidia plans to introduce.

articles.title: Fable Dev Happy About Delay To 2027 To Avoid “Chaotic Window,” And We All Know That Means GTA 6
articles.summary: Microsoft's new Fable game was supposed to launch this year, but it was delayed to February 2027. The game's director, Ralph Fulton, said in an interview that he feels "great" about the launch timing for Fable, adding that shifting to 2027 helps the game avoid the "chaotic window" of its original…
body: Speaking to IGN, Fulton said the reason for the delay "is pretty apparent to everybody." He said he was "really looking forward to" launching Fable in 2026, saying he wasn't happy about having another all-hands meeting with the team in January to tell them, "This is the year we ship Fable." But alas, that's what happened.

"The rationale for it is absolutely sound. I'm glad that we're avoiding that chaotic window," he said. In getting pushed to February 2027, Fable avoids launching near Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (October 23) and GTA 6 (November 19).

Fulton did not mention GTA 6 by name in this interview, but he did previously. In June, Fulton said Fable being delayed to 2027 helps Fable avoid a "really congested period" for game releases and "obviously avoiding Grand Theft Auto."
"Having a much less contested window allows us the opportunity to go out and really make a moment for ourselves, and I think the attention this game deserves,” he said.

articles.summary: Nvidia's controversial upscaling tech, DLSS 5, hasn't officially been released for its RTX 50-series computer chips. Files for the real-time neural rendering model were recently discovered in an early access build of N BA 2K27, so naturally, people raced to get it working.
body: Months later, DLSS 5 is accidentally back in the limelight. This time, however, Nvidia can't curate the footage of DLSS 5. So far, players have tested the tech out in games like The Last of Us Part 2, Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth, The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim, and Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas.
When applied to San Andreas CJ, the results are arguably more "realistic" — yet the protagonist almost looks like a different person.

"If only the training wasn't made with professional hdr edited photos and more with natural images it would look less weird and unnatural, they always look so high contrast hdr like and extremely lit with a fake blue sky light," one YouTube commenter remarked on PureDark's Skyrim video.
"It's like those Instagram vids but playable lol," another commenter opined on Jessica Natalia's San Andreas video.

articles.title: FX's Near-Perfect 11-Part Neo-Western Detective Series Is a Brilliant from Start to Finish
articles.summary: The best thing about an anthology show is that, if one season or episode is bad, there's no reason not to skip it. After all, nobody can force you to watch True Detective season 2 or that one Black Mirror episode with Miley Cyrus in it.
body: If you were to ask fans of the FX series Fargo to rank all five seasons of the show, nearly all of them would put season 4 at the bottom, and they wouldn’t be wrong. When compared to the other seasons of the series, there are fewer quirky Coen brothers-esque characters, making it less fun than the other seasons. Season 4 also moves a bit more slowly and, with the change in setting from Minnesota down to Kansas City, Missouri, the flavor of season 4 is also different, which is only exacerbated by the fact that it takes place in the early 1950s, far earlier than the other seasons.

articles.title: Path of Exile 2's first event league goes 'oops, all bosses' and reworks its worst mode so sane people can finally enjoy it
articles.summary: After the tremendous Return of the Ancients update to Path of Exile 2, it wouldn't take much to convince me to play more of it. The action RPG is the best it's ever been and finally feels ready to come out later this year.
body: On September 4, the first PoE 2 event league, Forbidden Rites, will begin. It's not like the other major updates we've seen with tons of balance changes and a whole new league mechanic. Instead, developer Grinding Gear Games is keeping this one pretty simple with a small twist to the campaign and a big rework to one of the most divisive endgame activities.

Ritual altars will show up during the campaign that spawn waves of monsters and reward you with loot. Some of them will spawn bosses on top of other bosses and will let you pocket a powerful unique item if you can survive the gauntlet. This is actually something that could already happen in the endgame version of the mechanic, so I can vouch for how fun it is to have bosses like the gorilla wielding a stone pillar appear out of thin air to crush you.
points: After the tremendous Return of the Ancients update to Path of Exile 2, it wouldn't take much to convince me to play more of it.

articles.title: The Most Unforgettable Apocalypse Action Movie of the 21st Century Is Officially Leaving Streaming
articles.summary: Movies about the end of the world have programmed us to never get attached to anybody, especially when the undead are involved. Assemble a group of survivors, give each of them a recognizable personality, and then gradually kill them off until only a lucky few remain.
body: With Zombieland leaving Netflix after Aug. 31, now is the perfect time to revisit the zombie apocalypse movie that remains as gloriously strange as it is entertaining, even after nearly two decades. It has everything you want in a zombie movie: memorable characters, great action sequences, elaborate kills, and a constant feeling of danger amidst all the blood and gore. But thanks to the charming chemistry between its actors, Zombieland feels like a transcendent experiment that earns the right to make some big swings.

The premise is simple: An anxious college student who goes by Columbus has survived the collapse of civilization by following a list of rules. “Cardio” is essential. So is “double tap,” where you always make sure a zombie is actually dead. He eventually encounters Tallahassee, a grumpy warrior driven by his search for Twinkies. The pair later crosses paths with con-artist sisters Wichita and Little Rock.
points: Movies about the end of the world have programmed us to never get attached to anybody, especially when the undead are involved.

articles.title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam review
articles.summary: The most surprising thing about Hell Let Loose: Vietnam is how much DNA it shares with Big Walk. They both frequently involve traversing large expanses of terrain. They both have excellent maps. Most of all, they're both fundamentally games about communication.
body: The difference is in how they encourage chatty players. Big Walk gently coaxes players out of their shells through the medium of ingenious puzzles and good vibes. Hell Let Loose: Vietnam forces you to chat with your random squadmates because if you don't you're going to get bombed to shit. Where Big Walk is all carrot, Hell Let Loose: Vietnam is all stick, and it will not hesitate to thwack you with it if you don't play by the rules.

Grappling with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam can be an intimidating experience. But while its teaching style is much harsher, it does yield rewards. When Hell Let Loose: Vietnam comes together—with dozens of players working in tandem to overcome the enemy—the resulting show is utterly captivating. Unfortunately, it doesn't come together quite often enough to justify the pain of getting to that point.
points: The most surprising thing about Hell Let Loose: Vietnam is how much DNA it shares with Big Walk.

articles.title: 5 samurai movies to watch before playing Onimusha: Way of the Sword
articles.summary:
Wes has been covering games and hardware for more than 10 years, first at tech sites like The Wirecutter and Tested before joining the PC Gamer team in 2014. Wes plays a little bit of everything, but he'll always jump at the chance to cover emulation and Japanese games.


When…
body: I wouldn't dream of telling you how to live your life, but if you're planning to play Onimusha: Way of the Sword on September 3, that gives you one weekend and approximately 120 waking hours to fill with samurai movies before the game's release. What else are you going to do— not watch so many classic Japanese films that you intuitively know how to walk the path of the blade the moment you pick up a controller as Miyamoto Musashi? Seems like a bad way to live to me.

But okay, benefit of the doubt: Maybe you're not planning to spend every second of the next week with your eyes peeled open going nuts on the Criterion Channel samurai tag because you have some appropriate gaming plans already established. Perfectly reasonable to devote the hours you could spend watching Akira Kurosawa's whole oeuvre to playing the remasters of the first two Onimusha games, Onimusha: Warlords and Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny, which are only about 3½ and 8½ hours long, respectively. You might even be able to rush through the first game more quickly than you could watch Seven Samurai!

videos.title: GTA 6 - Biggest Gameplay Changes From Grand Theft Auto 5
videos.summary: While they released Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018, it’s been 13 long years since Grand Theft Auto 5 first hit consoles, and the wait for the next numbered entry is almost over.
body: Grand Theft Auto 6 introduces sweeping, systemic updates to its open world, expanding heavily on the foundation of GTA5. Players will have to navigate a new Heat system that tracks outfits, vehicles, and accomplices alongside the classic wanted stars, while managing a dynamic Criminal Profile that influences NPC interactions much like the Honor system in Red Dead Redemption 2. With the addition of the WAINK scanner for complex carjacking, returning body stat mechanics reminiscent of San Andreas, and Leonida-specific side activities like fanboating and kayaking, the density of the world is taking a generational leap.
points: While they released Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018, it’s been 13 long years since Grand Theft Auto 5 first hit consoles, and the wait for the next numbered entry is almost over.
Following our first real look at gameplay and an exclusive chat with Rockstar, we are breaking down the massive leaps the franchise is making.
From the dynamic, evolving relationship between Jason and Lucia to entirely overhauled vehicle theft mechanics, this is a deep dive into the most exciting new features waiting for us.

videos.title: Fable - Combat Gameplay | PS5 Games
videos.summary: In Fable, you’ll flow seamlessly between melee, ranged, and magical abilities as you come face-to-face with classic creatures and new threats lurking across Albion.
body: Experiment with different loadouts, discover powerful spell combinations, and choose the combat style that feels right for you as you carve your own path through Albion.
Fable launches February 23, 2027. Pre-Order to receive the Pre-Order Content Pack, featuring the questionably heroic Chicken Suit and a collection of charming in-game gifts.
